description: Defines hashing and comparison utilities for Params structures, including ParamsHash, ParamsEqual, ParamsWrapper, and ParamsWrapperHash templates, used for efficient parameter handling in PyTorch's ATen library.

classes.name: ParamsHash
classes.description: Provides a hash function for Params objects using Fowler–Noll–Vo algorithm.

classes.name: ParamsEqual
classes.description: Provides an equality comparison for Params objects based on memory comparison.

classes.name: ParamsWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a POD type with explicit constructors and comparison operators to ensure safe memory handling.

classes.name: ParamsWrapperHash
classes.description: Provides a hash function for ParamsWrapper objects.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Computes hash for Params or ParamsWrapper objects.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Checks equality of two ParamsWrapper objects.
